Yogi Adityanath responds to Akhilesh Yadav's Ayodhya pledge

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has responded to Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav's pledge regarding Ayodhya. Adityanath questioned Yadav's history and suggested he would eventually repent his past actions and chant Lord Ram's name. The exchange highlights political rhetoric surrounding religious and historical narratives in the region.
